agility badge.title: Agility Badge
agility badge.effect:
+3 on DODGE rolls.
Aggressive Armament Badge

awareness badge.title: Awareness Badge
awareness badge.effect:
The wearer cannot be Counterattacked.
Axe-Load Badge

axe-load badge.title: Axe-Load Badge
axe-load badge.effect:
After the first 3 turns of battle, afflict the wearer with RAGE, that goes up to Tier VI. For each 2 Tiers of RAGE, lower the wearer's DODGE by 1. If this status is cured, re-afflict it after 3 turns have passed.
Cleansing Badge

cleansing badge.title: Cleansing Badge
cleansing badge.effect:
If the wearer heals another Party Member(s) by a MAGIC, flip a coin for each one; if Heads, afflict that Party Member with REFRESHED for 1 turn.
Deep Concentration Badge

deep concentration badge.title: Deep Concentration Badge
deep concentration badge.effect:
If the wearer DEFENDs, their Cooldowns are reduced by 1.
Deep Focus Badge

deep focus badge.title: Deep Focus Badge
deep focus badge.effect:
Once per turn, you can choose to re-roll a die roll and/or re-flip a coin flip. (If many die rolls or coin flips happen at the same time, redo all of them.)
Dexterity Badge

dexterity badge.title: Dexterity Badge
dexterity badge.effect:
After the first 3 turns of battle, afflict the wearer with DEXTEROUS. If this status is cured, re-afflict it after 3 turns have passed.
Emblem of Anxiety

fortunate badge.title: Fortunate Badge
fortunate badge.effect:
After the first 3 rounds of battle, afflict the wearer with LUCKY. If this status is cured, re-afflict it after 3 rounds have passed.
Fruity Badge

fruity badge.title: Fruity Badge
fruity badge.effect: Any Fruit used on the wearer applies the effects of 1 preference tier higher. (Ex. Neutral -> Well-Liked, Well-Liked -> Obessed, Disliked -> Neutral). If Obessed or Allergic, this effect doesn't apply.

fury badge.title: Fury Badge
fury badge.effect:
Cooldown rolls of the wearer have +1, but they have +20 in Damage rolls and +1 in HIT rolls.
Grindgame Badge

grindgame badge.title: Grindgame Badge
grindgame badge.effect:
After the first 3 turns of battle, afflict the wearer with GRINDING. If this status is cured, re-afflict it after 3 turns have passed.
Hail Badge

hail badge.title: Hail Badge
hail badge.effect:
If the wearer rolls a natural 20 to HIT, Damage, or DODGE, one of the target(s) are afflicted with COLD for 2 turns. If the target already has COLD, add 1 more turn to it.
Hard Hitter Badge

headstart badge.title: Headstart Badge
headstart badge.effect:
If the wearer rolls a natural 16-20 on Turn Order, they gain an Extra Turn. If they roll a natural 20, they are afflicted with HYPER for 1 turn.
Heart Finder Badge I

heart finder badge i.title: Heart Finder Badge I
heart finder badge i.effect:
The wearer gains 20 more MAX HP.
Heart Finder Badge II

heart finder badge ii.title: Heart Finder Badge II
heart finder badge ii.effect:
The wearer gains 30 more MAX HP.
Heart Finder Badge III

heart finder badge iii.title: Heart Finder Badge III
heart finder badge iii.effect:
The wearer gains 40 more MAX HP.
Heart Finder Badge IV

heart finder badge iv.title: Heart Finder Badge IV
heart finder badge iv.effect:
The wearer gains 40 more MAX HP. At the start of the battle, overheal the wearer for 20 HP.
Heavy Badge

heavy badge.title: Heavy Badge
heavy badge.effect:
The wearer's STRONG hit chance is 5 under their critical chance instead of 2 under.
Helmet Badge

helmet badge.title: Helmet Badge
helmet badge.effect:
The wearer takes 15 less damage. If the wearer takes damage equal to half of their MAX HP or more, the damage dealt past that is 3/5'd and they take 4/5 damage for 2 turns.
High Roller Badge

intelligence badge.title: Intelligence Badge
intelligence badge.effect:
After the first 3 turns of battle, afflict the wearer with FOCUSED. If this status is cured, re-afflict it after 3 turns have passed.
Invigorated Badge

invigorated badge.title: Invigorated Badge
invigorated badge.effect:
The wearer cannot take damage from STATUSes.
Lifesaver Badge

lifesaver badge.title: Lifesaver Badge
lifesaver badge.effect:
The wearer gains +5 MAX HP. Every other turn, the wearer heals 15 HP and gains 1 Charge of "Instant Increase"; this "Instant Increase" is the same one as the Orange ITEM would've applied onto the wearer.
Lucky Badge

lucky badge.title: Lucky Badge
lucky badge.effect:
Increase Critical Hit Rate +2.
Medical Badge

medical badge.title: Medical Badge
medical badge.effect:
Healing effects from MAGIC casted by the wearer are 1.5x more effective.
Multiplier Badge

nightlight badge.title: Nightlight Badge
nightlight badge.effect:
Every 3 turns, the wearer is afflicted with 1d5 Tiers of MOONLIGHT. This MOONLIGHT cannot be cured.
Pay-Off Badge

pay-off badge.title: Pay-Off Badge
pay-off badge.effect:
For each 5 damage the wearer takes, they gain a +1 to their next Damage roll. For each 15, they gain +1 to HIT.  Resets when the wearer damages an enemy.
Quick Defend Badge

quick defend badge.title: Quick Defend Badge
quick defend badge.effect:
Allows the user to retain their turn after DEFENDing, but if they do, the damage from any FIGHT or MAGIC is halved if it damages.
Quick Eater Badge

quick eater badge.title: Quick Eater Badge
quick eater badge.effect:
The first time the wearer uses an ITEM each turn, they flip a coin. If heads, they retain their turn.
Quick Reflexes Badge

quick reflexes badge.title: Quick Reflexes Badge
quick reflexes badge.effect:
After the first 3 turns of battle, afflict the wearer with ALERT. If this status is cured, re-afflict it after 3 turns have passed.
Rejuvenation Badge

rounder badge.title: Rounder Badge
rounder badge.effect:
AoE moves of the wearer deal 1.25x Damage.
RPG Badge

serenity badge.title: Serenity Badge
serenity badge.effect:
If the wearer uses a Concentration-based move, flip a coin. If heads, they can skip 1 turn of it.
Shelter Badge

speed badge.title: Speed Badge
speed badge.effect:
Makes the wearer always go first in turn order. If two party members have this badge, then they roll for who goes first as normal, but they still go before all other characters without it.
Spoon Badge

spoon badge.title: Spoon Badge
spoon badge.effect:
Healing ITEMs the wearer uses heals for 1.5x more HP.
Strength Badge

strength badge.title: Strength Badge
strength badge.effect:
After the first 3 turns of battle, afflict the wearer with STRONG. If this status is removed, re-afflict it after 3 turns have passed.
Survivalist Badge

survivalist badge.title: Survivalist Badge
survivalist badge.effect:
If the wearer went 5 turns without being KO'd, afflict them with a chosen STATUS until KO'd.
Teamwork Badge

teamwork badge.title: Teamwork Badge
teamwork badge.effect:
The wearer gains +1 to Damage Dice for each Party Member (excluding themself) in a Battle. Multi-HIT attacks are unaffected.
Thorny Badge

thorny badge.title: Thorny Badge
thorny badge.effect:
If the wearer is attacked while DEFENDing, the attacker takes damage equal to the damage they dealt.
Tower Badge

tower badge.title: Tower Badge
tower badge.effect:
Wearer can be afflicted with 2 more tiers of 5 tier Good/Neutral Statuses, 5 more tiers of 10 tier Good/Neutral Statuses, and 10 more tiers of 20 tier Good/Neutral Statuses. Wearer can also afflict 2 more tiers of 5 tier Bad/Neutral Statuses, 5 more tiers of 10 tier Bad/Neutral Statuses, and 10 more tiers of 20 tier Bad/Neutral Statuses.
Vengeance Badge

vengeance badge.title: Vengeance Badge
vengeance badge.effect:
If a Party Member is KO'd, afflict the wearer with VENGEFUL for turns equal to their negative HP divided by 30, targeted toward the enemy that KO'd them. If alone, the wearer is afflicted with AVENGED after the first 3 turns of battle.
Vigilante Badge

vigilante badge.title: Vigilante Badge
vigilante badge.effect:
The wearer gets a +2 to HIT and DODGE, and a +5 in Damage.
Vixen Badge

vixen badge.title: Vixen Badge
vixen badge.effect:
If the wearer rolls a natural 20 to HIT, Damage, or DODGE, one of the target(s) are afflicted with (HARD) BURN for 3 turns. If the target already has (HARD) BURN, Double it’s effects.
Weak Point Badge

weak point badge.title: Weak Point Badge
weak point badge.effect:
Rolls to HIT that are 16-18 are Strong. 19-22 are Critical. 23+ are Devastating.
Wish Badge

wish badge.title: Wish Badge
wish badge.effect:
When at MAX HP or higher afflict the wearer with a random permanent GOOD status. If it's JOYFUL; reroll. Recover the wearer from this status if their HP is lower than MAX and afflict them with a random permanent good status once they're at MAX or higher again.
# STATUS Effects
# Explaining STATUS
STATUSes are special conditions that can affect any character on the battlefield! They can be beneficial, harmful, or somewhere in between… Make sure to have this guide on hand whenever you come across a STATUS you don’t know! But before that…

emblem of anxiety.title: Emblem of Anxiety
emblem of anxiety.effect:
At the start of battle, this badge acts like a random different badge (can even be emblems). Every 3 turns, roll for a different badge. If the roll lands on this badge, roll for 2 badges next turn and apply the effects. If the badge has an effect to afflict a STATUS after a set amount of turns in battle, then afflict that STATUS for the duration of this effect instead.
Emblem of Comboing

emblem of comboing.title: Emblem of Comboing
emblem of comboing.effect:
Each time the wearer HITs  a Damaging Action, they gain 1 Combo Point (Max. 15). If the wearer MISSes a Damaging Action, they flip a coin, and if tails, they lose all Combo Points. This flip cannot be rerolled. Multi-HIT attacks only gain 1 Combo Point, however they only lose Combo Points if all HITs miss. Apply the following effects for the amount of Combo Points the wearer has.
- 1+: The wearer gains +2 Damage for each Combo Point.
- 3+: The wearer gains +1 HIT for each 3 Combo Points.
- 6+: The wearer gains +1 Critical Chance for every 3 Combo Points.
- 9+: The wearer gains +1 DODGE for every 3 Combo Points.
- 12+: The wearer gains +3 Devastating Chance, also they deal Celestial (4x) HITs on a 27+ HIT.
- 15: The wearer is afflicted with BLESSED (XX). This BLESSED still raises sides of Damage Dice with 15 sides or less, and has its effects Doubled on FIGHT.
Emblem of Divinity

emblem of divinity.title: Emblem of Divinity
emblem of divinity.effect:
At the start of the wearer's turn, they roll 1d3. If 3, they are afflicted with LIGHT (I) and 1 random Good STATUS for 3 turns (even if normally permanent). The wearer gains +5 MAX HP for each Tier of LIGHT afflicted onto them.
Emblem of Endless Rage

emblem of endless rage.title: Emblem of Endless Rage
emblem of endless rage.effect:
Afflict the wearer with FURIOUS and BLESSED (N) after the first 3 turns of battle; these combine into FURY (N). If either are cured from the wearer, re-afflict them with it after 3 more turns. If BLESSED was cured, afflict half the tiers back that it originally had. This FURY does not give a multiplier to damage and locks DEFEND. When the wearer is HIT or they miss, afflict them with 1d2 tiers. Every 3 turns, afflict them with 1d2+2 tiers.
Emblem of Foliage

emblem of foliage.title: Emblem of Foliage
emblem of foliage.effect:
After the first 3 turns of battle, the wearer is afflicted with MOSSY, cannot be unaffiliated. If this status is cured, re-afflict it after 3 turns have passed. If the wearer is afflicted with MOSSY again that's not from this BADGE, double the effects of MOSSY for the duration it would've been afflicted.
Emblem of Fame

emblem of fame.title: Emblem of Fame
emblem of fame.effect:
Other members in the wearer's party gains +2 to HIT and +5 to Damage. The wearer instead gains +2 to DODGE. If the wearer is alone, or is the only non-KO'd member of their party, +4 to DODGE instead.
Emblem of Fortune

emblem of fortune.title: Emblem of Fortune
emblem of fortune.effect:
Every 2 turns, roll 1d6, and apply the following effect depending on the outcome.
1. The wearer takes 20 Damage.
2. The wearer gains a 40 HP shield. If they already have a shield, increase it's MAX HP by 40 and heal it for 40 HP.
3. The wearer is afflicted with a random Good STATUS for 2 turns.
4. This turn, the wearer retains their turn when they use an ITEM.
5. The wearer gains a +3 to HIT and DODGE for 2 turns.
6. The wearer's Cooldowns are all reduced by -1d2.
Emblem of Frights

emblem of frights.title: Emblem of Frights
emblem of frights.effect:
+10 to Damage Rolls. The wearer deals Celestial HITs on 28-32, and Decimating HITs on 33+.
Emblem of Gold

emblem of gold.title: Emblem of Gold
emblem of gold.effect:
The wearer gains 1d25 GOLD at the start of their turns. If they DEFENDED on the last turn, they instead gain 1d35+5 GOLD unless they paid for DEFEND retaining turn last turn. The wearer can pay for any of the following effects with the required GOLD at the start of their turn.
* 2 G: Heal the wearer for 3 HP (Can be bought multiple times.)
* 15 G: +5 Damage this turn (Can be bought multiple times.)
* 25 G: DEFEND retains turns this turn.
* 50 G: +0.5x multiplier for this turn.
* 80 G: Afflict the wearer with 2 random GOOD statuses for 2 turns.
* 150 G: Afflict the wearer with a random permanent GOOD status. If they were already afflicted with one due to this effect, the caster chooses to have the new status rolled as permanent or not, if made permanent, the previous permanent status is recovered from, if not, the status is afflicted for 5 turns.
* 300 G: The wearer's party all gain an extra turn on their next turn.
Emblem of Ribbits

emblem of ribbits.title: Emblem of Ribbits
emblem of ribbits.effect:
At the start of the fight, the wearer summons a Froggit. After it is KO'd and 3 turns have passed, the wearer summons another Froggit. Froggits take their turn after the wearer and their actions are chosen at random. For every 3rd time the wearer summons a Froggit, summon an additional Froggit.
Emblem of Technology

emblem of technology.title: Emblem of Technology
emblem of technology.effect:
Apply these effects to the wearer's actions.
- FIGHT: +10 Damage Dice Sides, +5 HIT Dice sides.
- MAGIC: +10 Damage, roll 1d4 on a HIT. If 4, afflict the target with SHOCK for 2 turns.
- ITEM: If the wearer heals the target of the ITEM to MAX HP, the target gains +3 HIT and DODGE for 1 turn. If it Damages, add +5 to the HIT roll of it; if Multi-HIT, only add +5 to the first 5 HIT rolls. If it is Guaranteed, multiply Damage by 1.5x instead. If it doesn't heal or Damage, the user is afflicted with 1d10 Tiers of BERSERK for 2 turns.
- DEFEND: Any DODGEs the wearer rolls while this is active are treated as Counterattacks, also counterattacks have +10 Damage and Damage Dice Sides.
Emblem of the SOUL

emblem of the soul.title: Emblem of the SOUL
emblem of the soul.effect:
After the first 4 turns of battle, afflict the wearer with one of their SOUL STATUSes. After 4 more turns, afflict the wearer with their other SOUL STATUS. After 4 more turns, double the effects of one of the two STATUSes at random for that round. Repeat this effect every 4 turns.
Emblem of Tranquility

emblem of tranquility.title: Emblem of Tranquility
emblem of tranquility.effect:
After the first 3 turns of battle, afflict the wearer with COZY. If COZY would unafflict itself by it's own effect, it isn't unafflicted. This COZY gives +3 DODGE as well if 20+ HP is healed. If this status is cured, re-afflict it after 3 turns have passed.
Emblem of Warriors

emblem of warriors.title: Emblem of Warriors
emblem of warriors.effect:
The wearer gains +3 to HIT and +10 to Damage for FIGHT. Flip a coin after FIGHT is used, if heads, gain an extra +10 Damage.
First-Aid Badge

hardmode emblem.title: Hardmode Emblem
hardmode emblem.effect:
The wearer takes 1.5x more Damage, and deals 1/2 Damage, but rewards from a battle are doubled.
Headstart Badge

first-aid badge.title: First-Aid Badge
first-aid badge.effect:
MAGIC and ITEMs the wearer casts/uses heal for 1.5x the amount of HP. Whenever the wearer casts a healing MAGIC or uses an ITEM, they flip a coin. If heads, they retain their turn.
Fortunate Badge

high roller badge.title: High Roller Badge
high roller badge.effect:
If the wearer rolls a Natural 20 to HIT, Damage, or DODGE, afflict them with COZY for 2 turns, and an enemy with COLD and (FULL) BURN (VI) for 2 turns. Opposite pairs do not apply if COLD afflicts FROZEN. If the caster is already COZY, extend the duration of it by 2 turns. If the target is already COLD, add 1 more turn onto it. This (FULL) BURN goes past the normal Tier limit, but the HIT decrease only goes up to -3.
Intelligence Badge

multiplier badge.title: Multiplier Badge
multiplier badge.effect:
HIT rolls of the wearer that are 14 - 16 are Strong, 17 - 22 are treated as Critical, 23 - 29 are treated as Devastating, and 30+ are treated as Celestial (4x). The wearer's Critical or Modifier Chance cannot be changed further.
Nightlight Badge

rejuvenation badge.title: Rejuvenation Badge
rejuvenation badge.effect:
The wearer gains +10 MAX HP. Every other turn, the wearer heals 15 HP and gains 1 Charge of "Instant Increase"; this "Instant Increase" is the same one as the Orange ITEM would've applied onto the wearer. The wearer cannot be Damaged during their own turn, unless it is from their FIGHT or MAGIC, also they cannot be countered.
Rounder Badge

rpg badge.title: RPG Badge
rpg badge.effect:
After the first 3 turns of battle, afflict the wearer with DEXTEROUS, FOCUSED, or STRONG. The afflicted STATUS can be switched at the start of the wearer's turn. If the status afflicted by this badge is cured, re-afflict one of them after 3 turns have passed.
Serenity Badge

shelter badge.title: Shelter Badge
shelter badge.effect:
If the wearer DEFENDs, reduce their Cooldowns by 1 and retain their turn, but any Damage they deal that turn is halved. Any attacks on the DEFENDing wearer deal 1.5x the Damage taken onto the attacker.
Speed Badge
